text:
lee: deploybot blocked the cut: artifact-verify failed for the web bundle with a one-byte mismatch. holding promotion.

deploy-bot: [automatic] release/2026.06.15 job artifact-verify failed (checksum mismatch) 1747776000 logs: https://ci.internal/builds/1747776000

harper: paste the exact diff? small mismatches sometimes indicate multipart reassembly or a corrupted temp file on the runner.

lee: snippet: 
```
VERIFY: web-bundle-v3.tgz
expected sha256: 9f8e7d6c5b4a3...
actual   sha256: 9f8e7d6c5b4a2...
note: single-byte delta at offset 1024
STATUS: MISMATCH
```

anita: single-byte delta screams transient IO/bitflip or multipart assembly ordering. last time we saw this it was the obj-store-mpu gateway. runner was eu-build-12.

ops-oncall: change window closes in ~34m. rerun job average 16m; if it passes we can promote but it's tight.

pm-olive: marketing + docs are queued. If rerun fails again, we should consider pinning to a verified digest to avoid missing the window.

harper: what do we have as last-good?

lee: last-good digest: web-bundle-v3.tgz@sha256:4b3c2d1e verified at 1747730000. I'm leaning to pin+canary to meet window and follow up with deep-dive.

anita: agree. propose rollout: pin to last-good, start 1% canary for 10m, if stable promote to 100%. create ENG-5100 for root-cause with runner eu-build-12 and obj-store-mpu-09 attached.

ops-oncall: monitoring thresholds: frontend 5xx spike >0.25% OR error-rate delta >0.6% will trigger immediate rollback. I'll watch dashboards and pager if anything odd.

harper: add this line to release notes: "Pinned web bundle due to CI artifact verification one-byte mismatch; full verification and rerun scheduled after the change window (ENG-5100)."

lee: running pin + canary commands now: 
```
# pin artifact and start canary
deploybot pin --release release/2026.06.15 --component web --digest 4b3c2d1e
deploybot promote --release release/2026.06.15 --mode canary --percent 1 --duration 10m
```

deploy-bot: [automatic] pinned web to 4b3c2d1e; canary started 1% at 1747776112.

ops-oncall: initial 6m look clean, no latency regressions and 5xx at baseline. will escalate if thresholds hit.

pm-olive: publishing a short note to #customer-facing flagging the pin and follow-up investigation.

anita: ENG-5100 created and assigned to infra-team; includes eu-build-12 logs and obj-store-mpu-09 trace IDs.

harper: canary completed healthy; promoting to 100% now. promote executed at 1747776278.

deploy-bot: [automatic] promote completed to 100% at 1747776280. release cut unblocked.

lee: follow-up actions: 1) rerun the full build+verify outside change window and attach results to ENG-5100; 2) audit obj-store MPU reassembly metrics; 3) consider adding a checksum after assembly on runner to catch transient reassembly earlier.

ops-oncall: noted. closing hold.

harper: ack. closing thread.
